normalization: Each original character is casefolded and NFKD decomposed; combining marks are removed for retrieval only. An offset map preserves exact original-language source substrings. Original reports are unchanged.

rules.purpose: Clinical-significance qualifiers, in positive or negative wording; exact negation and scope require source reading.
Qualified absence/normality or exclusion of only higher-grade findings; does not itself decide absence or thresholds.
Potentially qualified cartilage preservation; all OA compartments are retrieval candidates until anatomy is independently read.
Cartilage diagnoses/grades can omit depth, extent, or compartment; tokens only identify material to assess.
Retrieve cartilage depth/extent language when linked by exact existing evidence or local cartilage terms. It may fully support the existing label.
Fluid quantity vocabulary; collection identity, location, comparison, and true amount remain semantic questions.
ACL/MCL partial tears and sprains need qualifying severity/acuity, which this lexical hit does not establish.

target_association: A trigger associates with a target only if it overlaps one of that target's exact inspection-effective source-evidence occurrences, or if its bounded source excerpt also contains a target-family lexical anchor. OA family anchors deliberately nominate all three compartments; this is not inferred compartment localization. Fluid proximity does not prove joint versus bursal/cyst location.
excerpt_boundaries: At most 180 original characters on each side of the match, reduced to nearby period, semicolon, exclamation, question mark, or newline boundaries. These locators are not sufficient clinical context; full reports are supplied separately.

additional_screens.selection: All currently observed-positive OA targets, regardless of wording; direct exact existing evidence is supplied, with no claim that it is wrong.
Observed-positive Effusion/Baker targets whose exact evidence has no match to the bounded grade vocabulary; no synonym-completeness claim.

priority_order.P1_observed_direct_evidence_or_positive_: Current positive/negative state and direct exact evidence overlap or one of the additional positive-state screens.
priority_order.P2_observed_source_proximity: Current positive/negative state linked only by bounded lexical source proximity.
priority_order.P3_currently_masked: Current uncertain/not_mentioned target; no new observed supervision proposed.

exclusion_scope: Only exact no-relevant-prior-comparison phrasing is excluded, and every such exclusion retains its exact source locator separately.
known_limits: The lexicon covers observed English, French, Spanish, German, Greek and Turkish wording plus some cognates. It is not exhaustive language identification or semantic analysis.
Substrings, compound words, misspellings, unusual synonyms, and local excerpt boundaries can cause misses or false positives. Complete artifact scanning does not prove complete semantic coverage.
Literal quantities or diagnoses may already support the label; a hit is never a proposed correction.
History/indication, comparison, negation scope, laterality, postoperative status, and target identity must be determined from each full report by an independent reader.
The existing review state and evidence are used only for audit association and priority. No source-first blindness is claimed for this discovery task.
Source packet membership discloses that a lexical or positive-state screen fired. Readers must freeze all source decisions before opening candidate details.
